variants.headline: Union calls a strike
variants.sub: A strike has been called by the union {name}.
variants.body:
The union {name} has called a strike. The call establishes a labour action, not an account of its participation or outcome. Readers considering {target} should distinguish the decision to call a strike from unreported claims about wages, conditions or the response of an employer.

The right to act together matters because an individual worker need not have an equal voice in a bargain. A strike call should be considered with that imbalance in mind. Solidarity is a serious commitment, not a reason to invent either the demands or the outcome of this dispute.

We criticise {target} in this dispute. Labour relations call for a responsible standard, and a strike call is an appropriate moment to question whether the interests at stake have been handled adequately. Ordinary lives should be the measure, not a convenient afterthought.

variants.sub: The union {name} has issued a call for strike action.
